evals.prompt: I have monthly revenue and user data. Generate a quarterly executive dashboard PDF with a title slide, a KPI table, a bar chart for revenue, a line chart for users, and a closing slide. Use the light theme.
evals.expected_output: A JSON config for the dashboard with title, table, chart, and closing slides, plus a local presentation CLI command ending in .pdf.
assertions: The config has 5+ slides covering title, table, chart, and closing types
The theme is set to light
Chart datasets reference revenue and users
The CLI command uses pnpm cli presentation and an output ending in .pdf

evals.prompt: Turn this survey JSON into a PowerPoint: [{question: Satisfaction, score: 4.5}, {question: NPS, score: 72}]. Use a dark theme with accent #00ff88.
evals.expected_output: A JSON config with title, table, and bar chart slides, a dark theme overridden with the emerald accent, and a .pptx command.
assertions: Config has exactly 3 slides: title, table, and chart
Chart labels match the survey questions
Table headers match question and score

evals.prompt: Create an HTML deck with a gallery of four screenshots, an embedded demo video, and a feature bullet list. Use the corporate theme and a local logo.
evals.expected_output: A JSON config with title, gallery, video, and bullets slides, corporate theme with logo override, and an .html command.
assertions: Video slide has a local src
Theme is corporate with a logo override
